We identify, build and scale high-potential opportunities in FinTech, crypto asset services, AI technology, digital economy infrastructure and education technology.

intro.title: Bridging Global Capital With Vietnam's Digital Economy
intro.p1: Vietnam is entering a defining moment — with Resolution 5/2025/NQ-CP effective from 9 September 2025 launching a regulated crypto asset market pilot, a booming digital economy, and a young tech-savvy population creating an unprecedented window for responsible capital deployment.
intro.p2: AXVN Tech Holding connects international capital with Vietnam's fastest-growing opportunities in FinTech, crypto asset infrastructure, digital transformation and education technology.
intro.p3: From licensed crypto asset service platforms and FinTech infrastructure to AI technology and EdTech — we bring not just capital, but strategic partnership, regulatory knowledge and hands-on experience to build genuinely sustainable businesses together.
